To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquin oral suspensions may be prepared using a simple method and can be administered to patients without altering their efficacy.
the drug content of the chloroquine and the hydroxychloroquin oral suspension can be filtered and centrifuged without any alteration of the drug content.
chloroquine and its analogue hydroxychloroquinone can be compounded as an oral suspension and can be filtered and centrifuged without affecting their assay.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of chloroquine or hydroxychloroquin oral suspensions for paediatric use and for the enteral nutrition in intensive care units.
the pharmacopeial procedures for the preparation and purification of oral suspension formulations containing chloroquine or hydroxychloroquin.

the development of an effective protocol for the production of a safe and effective oral suspension of chloroquine/hydoxychloroquine for the treatment of patients affected by severe forms of COVID 19.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the drug assay of compounded chloroquine/hydr oxychloroquine oral suspensions can be preserved after filtration and/or centrifugation.
the filtration and/or centrifugation procedures do not affect the drug assay of chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquin oral suspension.

the use of a filter and/or a centrifuge to prepare an oral suspension from tablets containing chloroquine or hydroxychloroqua is not recommended, as this procedure can lead to a reduction of the drug content in the preparation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data presented in this article can be useful to support the development of a compounding procedure for the preparation of a stable oral suspension of chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquin.
the drug content in the suspension is not significantly affected by filtration/centrifugation and the drug can be prepared and administered to patients with severe COVID 19.
the drug substance can be recovered from a suspension of chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquines by filtration or centrifugation without any loss of drug content.
The main takeaway from our work is that
chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquin oral suspensions can be filtered and/centrifuged and administered through a nasogastrically placed tube without affecting the drug content.
chloroquine/hydoxychloroquine suspensions can be prepared and administered in a safe and reliable way to patients affected by severe forms of COVID 19, especially children.
the use of a syringe filter or of a centrifugation step is not necessary to prepare a stable oral suspension for the administration of chloroquine and/or hydroxychloroquines to COVID 19 patients.
